title: Find it on the shelf
prompt: Go to the shelf and find this book (the guide will tell you its title). Tell me the call number written on its spine label.
hint: Open the record, check the copy details, and note the classification number before the author mark.
reflect: How would you find a different book on the same subject next time?

title: Know the rules
prompt: How many days can a student keep a borrowed book?
hint: Ask the guide about library rules for students.
reflect: Which library rule surprised you most?

title: First search
prompt: Search the catalogue for books on surveying. Give the title of any one book you find.
hint: Try a single word such as 'surveying' rather than a long sentence.
reflect: What word would you try next to find more results?

title: Standards matter
prompt: Which Indian Standard (IS number) covers the code of practice for plain and reinforced concrete?
hint: Indian Standards are written as 'IS' followed by a number and a year. Look in the reference collection.
reflect: Why might a standard be more reliable than a website for lab work?

title: Cite it right
prompt: Write a reference for any book you have borrowed, with author, title, place: publisher, and year.
hint: Start with the author's surname, then initials, then the title, then place: publisher, then year.
reflect: Why does a reference need the year of publication?

title: Borrow and return on time
prompt: Borrow any book from the library and return it on or before its due date. Then tell me you are done.
hint: The quest completes once Koha records the return on or before the due date.
reflect: Was the book useful beyond your syllabus?

title: Visit the reading room
prompt: Spend some time in the reading room and tell me one thing you read there.
hint: Any newspaper, magazine or book counts.
